fact: The West Cleft District homes are burrows clawed into the cavern walls.
source_quote: Its homes were nothing more than burrows clawed into the cavern walls
subject: West Cleft District

fact: The streets of the West Cleft District are a chaotic tangle of structures piled atop one another.
source_quote: its streets were a chaotic tangle of structures piled atop one another
subject: West Cleft District

fact: The West Cleft District is filled with the muttering, screaming, and raving of hundreds of Derro.
source_quote: the muttering, screaming, and raving of hundreds of Derro filled the air
subject: West Cleft District

fact: The West Cleft District is described as a wretched place with overwhelming stench.
source_quote: The West Cleft District was a wretched place... The stench was overwhelming
subject: West Cleft District

fact: Droki is a pale-faced Derro wearing a floppy hat adorned with two tentacle-like protrusions.
source_quote: He was a pale-faced Derro in a floppy hat adorned with two tentacle-like protrusions
subject: Droki

fact: Droki moved with unnatural, almost magical speed.
source_quote: moved with an unnatural, almost magical speed
subject: Droki

fact: Droki vanished down a narrow fissure hidden behind scraps of canvas and moldy boxes.
source_quote: he vanished down a narrow fissure hidden behind scraps of canvas and moldy boxes
subject: Droki

fact: Buppido bolts after Droki when the Derro vanishes into the fissure.
source_quote: Buppido immediately bolted after him
subject: Buppido chases Droki

fact: The party decides not to restrain Buppido to avoid causing a scene.
source_quote: Rather than cause a scene restraining him in a place full of Derro, the party let him go
subject: Party decision on Buppido

fact: The party squeezes through the gap into the tunnels beyond.
source_quote: the party let him go and then squeezed through the gap into the tunnels beyond
subject: Party enters tunnels

fact: The Whorlstone Tunnels have air that tastes faintly of metal.
source_quote: The air tasted faintly of metal
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Sound is strangely muted in the Whorlstone Tunnels.
source_quote: all sound was strangely muted, as though the cavern itself had swallowed every echo
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Swirling patterns of faerzress cast dancing spirals of soft light across the stone pillars in the Whorlstone Tunnels.
source_quote: Swirling patterns of faerzress... cast dancing spirals of soft light across the jagged stone pillars
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Bigwigs are peculiar mushrooms that swell whoever consumes them.
source_quote: peculiar mushrooms the locals called bigwigs... which were said to swell... whoever consumed them
subject: bigwigs

fact: Pygmyworts are peculiar mushrooms that shrink whoever consumes them.
source_quote: pygmyworts... which were said to... shrink whoever consumed them
subject: pygmyworts

fact: The party takes one bigwig and one pygmywort.
source_quote: The party took one of each
subject: Party collects fungi

fact: Following Droki might lead the party to every faction he serves.
source_quote: They realized that following the courier might lead them to every faction he served
subject: Droki's patrons

fact: Thorin proposes yelling for Droki.
source_quote: Thorin proposes yelling for Droki
subject: Thorin

fact: Buppido tells the party to stay on the down low.
source_quote: Buppido makes clear they should stay on the down low
subject: Buppido

fact: The party chooses to find Droki before the cave entrance.
source_quote: The party chooses to find Droki before the cave entrance
subject: Party strategy

fact: The gate guards meet Buppido with the usual set of contempt.
source_quote: the gate guards meet him with "the usual set of contempt"
subject: Gate guards

fact: Derro in the district look at the party with burning hatred.
source_quote: Those who spot the party look at them "with a burning hatred"
subject: Derro

fact: The ceilings in the Whorlstone Tunnels rise about 50 feet and drop to 25 in the narrow tunnels.
source_quote: The ceilings in the tunnels rise about 50 feet and drop to 25 in the narrow tunnels
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Gyrgum worries about eating too much bigwig because only a medium creature fits through the fissure.
source_quote: Gyrgum worries about eating too much bigwig, since only a medium creature fits through the fissure
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Droki heads north through the tunnels.
source_quote: Droki heads north
subject: Droki's direction

fact: The party follows Droki openly.
source_quote: The party follows openly
subject: Party tracking
